summary: On the TCP transport with the durable authority ledger (0.35.0), two SHARED holders of one resource releasing concurrently while an EX waiter is queued make the master decide the EX over a holder whose bit is still durable: promote_waiters treated EVERY PENDING_RELEASE holder as already gone, not only the one being retired in the current transition. The bundled ledger transition [release, grant EX] is refused by the ledger (P-TAUTH-DOUBLE-GRANT 'req EX vs record holders=<sibling bit>'), and the refusal strands the release: the entry is kept PENDING_RELEASE 'for the releaser to retry', the releaser's retry is ACKed OK as a duplicate, and nothing ever retires the record. The stranded entry blocks every later EX on the resource as a holder and keeps the page 'in flight' forever, so the ordered page handoff can never freeze-drain it (P-TAUTH-FREEZE-DRAIN-TIMEOUT x94 on page 1786 = the ROOT INODE's page on test2), every requester of that page gets REMASTER (P74-GRANT status=12 x4381 fleet-wide), 'lock request failed after 10 retries' x54, 26 mounts abort. A refused grant was also terminal for the requester (MXFS_ERR_LEDGER -> -EIO) although the cause was transient.
mechanism: dlm/dlm.c: (1) promote_waiters used lk_is_live_holder(), which excludes PENDING_RELEASE — documented as 'the one being retired in this very transition' but applied to ALL of them; releases are processed concurrently on the master (local unlock threads vs the receive thread), so a sibling holder in PENDING_RELEASE (its own commit in flight) was invisible and the EX was decided over its durable bit. (2) dlm_txn_commit bundles release + successor grants in one ledger commit; tauth_ledger.c apply_op refuses the grant with -EBUSY (DOUBLE-GRANT, fail-closed by the sess424 ruling) which fails the whole bundle. (3) dlm_txn_finalize on a refused bundle kept the release entry PENDING_RELEASE ('the releaser retries') and ACKed MXFS_ERR_LEDGER; the releaser's resend hit process_remote_release's PENDING_RELEASE branch, which ACKed MXFS_OK as a 'duplicate' — the releaser stopped, the master never re-drove it. (4) A denied grant (MXFS_ERR_LEDGER) mapped to -EIO at the requester. Reproduced deterministically in usermode (tests/tauth/concurrent_release_test, one-shot ledger commit-delay knob): first lap on the unfixed engine = P-TAUTH-DOUBLE-GRANT 'EX vs holders=0x2', B's EX rc=-5 after 70 ms, platter record holders=0x4 stuck, 1 in-flight entry on the page forever, A's release ACKed OK. Design-consult ruling (sess425 consult, banked in docs/rulings/concurrent-release-fix-shape.md): (1)+(2) sound with 'every retirement triggers a promotion re-scan'; the master must re-commit the release alone and never depend on the releaser; a retry finding PENDING_RELEASE must not be ACKed OK; invariant: every PENDING_* entry has exactly one live master-owned driver.
